}

/* ── Bar-Kopf «Abzüge auf dem Tisch» (Roberts Wahl Nr. 19 aus _varianten/bar-kopf-20.html, 20.10.2026, unteres Bild: Bar statt Feuer) ── */
.kp-abz{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) auto;align-items:center;gap:clamp(20px,2.4vw,40px);min-height:max(100svh,640px);padding:calc(var(--leiste-h) + 34px) max(var(--rand),calc((100vw - var(--breit))/2)) 44px;background:linear-gradient(160deg,#3a1f17,#24120e);color:var(--kalk);overflow:clip}
.kp-abz__text .titel{font-size:clamp(2.8rem,6.4vw,6.2rem);line-height:1;margin:0 0 .26em}
.kp-abz__text .lauf{color:#E6DCCF;margin:0 0 30px;max-width:30ch}
.kp-abz__tisch{position:relative;width:min(56vw,calc((100svh - var(--leiste-h) - 84px) * 1.055),980px);aspect-ratio:760/720}
.kp-abz__p{position:absolute}
.kp-abz__ab{width:100%;height:100%;background:#f6f1e8;padding:clamp(8px,1vw,15px) clamp(8px,1vw,15px) clamp(26px,3.2vw,48px);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -16px rgba(0,0,0,.8)}
.kp-abz__ab .rb{width:100%;height:100%}
.kp-abz__p1{left:1%;top:5%;width:44%;height:64%;transform:rotate(-5deg)}
.kp-abz__p2{left:28%;top:49%;width:70%;height:50%;transform:rotate(4deg)}
.kp-abz__p3{left:53%;top:1%;width:42%;height:62%;transform:rotate(3deg)}
@media (max-width:860px){
  .kp-abz{grid-template-columns:1fr;min-height:0;padding:calc(var(--leiste-h) + 40px) var(--rand) 60px;gap:40px}
  .kp-abz__tisch{width:100%;max-width:520px;justify-self:center}
}
/* Weinkarte: Landschaften im Kopf zoomen beim Überfahren nur noch ganz leise (Robert 20.10.2026, Chat Wein: «noch ein bisschen sanfter»). Bewusst ohne @media (hover:hover): sticht die frühere Regel aus. */
.kb-gefach__bild{transition:transform 2.6s cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)!important}
.kb-gefach:hover .kb-gefach__bild{transform:scale(1.02)!important}
/* Das Haus: Kopf «Wort in der Mitte» (Roberts Wahl Nr. 3 aus _varianten/haus-kopf-15b/, 20.10.2026), löst Bilderreihe + Band + Zitat-Platte ab */
.dhm{background:var(--riegel);padding-top:var(--leiste-h)}
.dhm__w.rm{grid-template-columns:.8fr 1.1fr .8fr;grid-template-rows:auto clamp(160px,16vw,240px);border-radius:0}
.dhm__t{background:var(--tief) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px;padding:clamp(34px,3.6vw,64px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;align-items:center;text-align:center;min-height:min(620px,calc(68svh - var(--leiste-h)))}
.dhm__t .kp-lamm{margin:0 auto 14px}
.dhm .titel{font-size:clamp(3rem,5.6vw,5.8rem);margin:0 0 .35em}
.dhm__z{font:440 clamp(1.15rem,1.55vw,1.5rem)/1.45 Petrona,serif;color:#F1E8DC;margin:0 0 1.4em;max-width:24em}
.dhm__z .mono{display:block;margin-top:12px;color:var(--gold-hell)}
.dhm__s{grid-column:1/-1}
@media (max-width:860px){.dhm__w.rm{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-template-rows:auto 60vw 40vw}.dhm__t{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1;min-height:0}.dhm__s{grid-row:3}}

/* Bar «Wie das Menü» (Robert 20.10.2026, Fassung 1 aus _varianten/bar-15): Riegelwand mit je zwei Bildern links und rechts, Barkarte auf Papier mit Lamm. .ruh-Regeln unbenutzt */
.bm{padding:var(--pol) 0}
.bm__w{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.85fr) minmax(0,1.2fr) minmax(0,.85fr);gap:var(--fuge);padding:var(--fuge);background:var(--riegel)}
.bm__s{display:grid;grid-template-rows:1fr 1fr;gap:var(--fuge)}
.bm__b{position:relative;margin:0;overflow:hidden;background:var(--dunkel)}.bm__b>.rb{position:absolute;inset:0}
.bm__k{position:relative;background:#FBFAF7;color:var(--tinte);text-align:center;border-radius:3px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;padding:clamp(34px,3.4vw,54px) clamp(26px,3vw,48px);
  box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 2px var(--riegel),inset 0 0 0 9px #FBFAF7,inset 0 0 0 10px rgba(179,131,70,.6),0 50px 90px -46px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.bm__lamm{display:block;width:34px;margin:0 auto 12px;color:var(--gold)}.bm__lamm svg{display:block;width:100%;height:auto}
.bm__kopf{color:var(--riegel);margin:0 0 12px}
.bm__k .titel{font-size:clamp(1.9rem,2.8vw,2.7rem);margin:0;color:var(--titel)}.bm__k .titel em{color:var(--riegel)}
.bm__satz{font-size:16px;line-height:1.55;color:#4a3b36;max-width:36ch;margin:14px auto 18px}
.bm__liste{list-style:none;margin:0;padding:0;width:100%}
.bm__liste li{padding:clamp(12px,1vw,16px) 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.14)}.bm__liste li:last-child{border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.14)}
.bm__liste b{display:block;font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:500;font-size:clamp(1.02rem,1.25vw,1.22rem);letter-spacing:.15em;color:var(--titel)}
.bm__liste span{display:block;margin-top:4px;font-family:Petrona,serif;font-size:clamp(1rem,1.1vw,1.1rem);color:var(--gold-tief)}
.bm__zeit{color:var(--gold-tief);margin:20px 0 18px}
@media (max-width:860px){.bm__w{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr}.bm__k{grid-column:1/-1;grid-row:1}.bm__s{grid-template-rows:none}.bm__b{aspect-ratio:3/4}}

/* Feiern auf der Startseite «Platte gespiegelt» (Robert 20.10.2026, Fassung 4): Stube gross, Platte rechts darauf, Festsaal klein unten links */
.pg{padding:var(--pol) 0 calc(var(--pol) + 40px)}
.pg__b{position:relative;padding:0 var(--rand) clamp(120px,12vw,180px)}
.pg figure{margin:0}
.pg__a{width:70%}.pg__a .rb{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.pg__s{position:absolute;left:calc(var(--rand) + 5%);bottom:0;width:24%;z-index:1}.pg__s .rb{aspect-ratio:4/3}
.pg__a .rb,.pg__s .rb{border-radius:2px;box-shadow:0 1px 2px rgba(48,25,22,.10),0 6px 12px -4px rgba(48,25,22,.12),0 22px 36px -14px rgba(48,25,22,.20),0 48px 70px -30px rgba(48,25,22,.30)}
.pg__s figcaption{margin-top:12px;color:var(--gold-tief)}
.pg__box{position:absolute;top:clamp(36px,4vw,64px);right:var(--rand);width:min(560px,40%);z-index:2}
.pg__feld{width:100%;background:var(--kalk);padding:clamp(30px,3vw,48px);display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:16px;align-items:flex-start;
  box-shadow:0 2px 4px rgba(48,25,22,.10),0 26px 50px -16px rgba(48,25,22,.45),0 70px 110px -50px rgba(48,25,22,.5)}
.pg__lamm{display:block;width:38px;color:var(--gold)}.pg__lamm svg{width:100%;height:auto;display:block}
.pg__feld .titel{margin:0;font-size:clamp(2.1rem,3.3vw,3.2rem)}
.pg__feld .lauf{color:#4a4040;font-size:clamp(15.5px,1.1vw,17px);line-height:1.65;margin:0}
.pg__feld .tl__wahl button{text-align:left}
.pg__feld .tl__wahl button span{font-size:clamp(1.15rem,1.4vw,1.375rem)}
.pg__fuss{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-end;gap:16px;width:100%;flex-wrap:wrap}
.pg__fuss .tl__richt{align-items:flex-start}.pg__fuss .tl__richt b{font-size:clamp(2.2rem,3vw,2.8rem);white-space:nowrap}
@media (max-width:860px){.pg__b{padding-bottom:0}.pg__a{width:100%}.pg__s{display:none}.pg__box{position:relative;inset:auto;width:auto;margin-top:-40px}.pg__feld .tl__wahl button span{white-space:normal}}

/* Karte: «Aus der Küche» als Mauer wie bei Salt & Silver, eckig, mit Rahmen, Zoom beim Hereinkommen und leichtem Vergrössern beim Überfahren (Robert 20.10.2026: «so haben … eckigen … diesem Effekt») */
.karte-tw .tw.rm{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));grid-auto-rows:clamp(150px,19.5vw,290px);grid-auto-flow:dense;gap:clamp(12px,1.4vw,22px);background:none;padding:0;border-radius:0;align-items:stretch}
.karte-tw .tw.rm>div{margin:0!important;min-height:0;padding:7px;background:rgba(48,25,22,.045);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(48,25,22,.11)}
.karte-tw .tw.rm>.tw__b--2{grid-row:span 2}
.karte-tw .tw.rm .rb{height:100%!important;aspect-ratio:auto!important;border-radius:0!important}
@media (hover:hover){.karte-tw .tw.rm>div.da:hover .rb img{transform:scale(1.04)}}
@media (max-width:860px){.karte-tw .tw.rm{grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;grid-auto-rows:34vw}}


/* ===== Weinkarte · Wein zum Menü und die ganze Karte (Chat Wein, 20.10.2026; aus _varianten/wein-planer.css, nur mit body.weinneu wirksam) ===== */
.weinneu .kb-karte,.weinneu .kb-mitte{display:none!important}

:root{--feder:cubic-bezier(.34,1.42,.64,1);--sanft:cubic-bezier(.22,1,.36,1)}


/* Gemeinsam: das alte Pult bleibt unsichtbar als Rechenwerk */
.weinneu .kb-pult{display:none}
.weinneu .kb-geschmack{padding-top:clamp(28px,3vw,44px)}
.pl{position:relative;background:#FBFAF7;border-radius:16px;padding:clamp(24px,3.4vw,56px);box-shadow:0 50px 90px -60px rgba(48,25,22,.55),0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.06)}
.pl-ueber{color:var(--riegel);margin:0 0 10px}
.pl-h{font-size:clamp(2rem,3.4vw,3.2rem);margin:0}
.pl-frage{font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:460;font-size:clamp(1.55rem,2.2vw,2.15rem);color:var(--titel);margin:0 0 6px;line-height:1.15}
.pl-satz{color:#5a4c48;font-size:16.5px;margin:0 0 22px;max-width:52ch}
.pl-unter{font:400 12px/1.4 "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--riegel);margin:30px 0 12px}
.pl-quelle{color:#8a7a74;font-size:12.5px;margin:22px 0 0;max-width:80ch}
.pl-leeren{border:0;background:none;color:var(--riegel);cursor:pointer;padding:8px 0;font-size:11.5px}
.pl-mehr{margin-top:14px;border:0;background:none;color:var(--riegel);font:500 15px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;padding:6px 0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.35)}

/* Kacheln: drücken federt, gewählt bekommt Rahmen und Haken */
.pl-raster{display:grid;gap:12px}
.pl-raster--bild{grid-template-columns:repeat(8,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-pop .pl-raster--bild,.pl-k5 .pl-raster--bild{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-rest{display:contents}.pl-rest[hidden]{display:none}
.pl-raster--art{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-raster--wort{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-raster--zwei{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));max-width:calc(66.66% - 4px)}
.pl-raster--land{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-raster--preis{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-k{position:relative;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;color:var(--tinte);text-align:left;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:14px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.12),0 10px 24px -20px rgba(48,25,22,.5);transition:transform .5s var(--feder),box-shadow .35s var(--sanft);-webkit-tap-highlight-color:transparent}
@media (hover:hover){.pl-k:hover{transform:translateY(-3px);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.2),0 22px 34px -22px rgba(48,25,22,.55)}}
.pl-k:active{transform:scale(.96);transition-duration:.12s}
.pl-k[aria-pressed="true"]{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--riegel),0 22px 34px -22px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.pl-haken{position:absolute;top:10px;right:10px;width:24px;height:24px;border-radius:50%;background:var(--riegel);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transform:scale(0);transition:transform .45s var(--feder)}
.pl-haken svg{width:14px;height:14px;fill:none;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:2;stroke-linecap:round;stroke-linejoin:round}
.pl-k[aria-pressed="true"] .pl-haken,.pl-st[aria-pressed="true"] .pl-haken{transform:scale(1)}
.pl-k__t{display:block;font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.3;font-weight:500}
.pl-k__t small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:13.5px;color:#7a6a64;margin-top:3px}
/* Bild-Kachel (Gerichte, Duft) */
.pl-k--bild{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:18px 10px 16px}
.pl-k__bild{width:92px;height:92px;margin-bottom:12px;display:block}
.pl-k__bild img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .6s var(--feder)}
.pl-k[aria-pressed="true"] .pl-k__bild img{transform:scale(1.08)}
/* Art mit echter Flasche */
.pl-k--art{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;padding:16px 10px 16px}
.pl-k__fl{height:150px;display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center;margin-bottom:12px}
.pl-k__fl img{max-height:100%;width:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 12px 10px rgba(48,25,22,.25));transition:transform .6s var(--feder)}
.pl-k--art[aria-pressed="true"] .pl-k__fl img{transform:translateY(-6px)}
.pl-k--art .pl-k__t{font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:470;font-size:18px;color:var(--titel)}
.pl-k--art em{display:block;font-style:normal;color:var(--riegel);font-size:10.5px;margin-top:8px}
/* Wort-Kachel (Körper, Säure) */
.pl-k--wort{padding:20px 20px 18px}
.pl-k--wort .pl-k__t{font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:470;font-size:20px;color:var(--titel)}
.pl-punkte{display:flex;gap:5px;margin-bottom:12px}.pl-punkte i{width:22px;height:5px;border-radius:3px;background:var(--kalk-tief)}.pl-punkte i.voll{background:var(--riegel)}
/* Land mit Landschaft */
.pl-k--land{padding:0;overflow:hidden}
.pl-k__land{display:block;height:118px;background-size:cover;background-position:center;transition:transform .9s var(--sanft)}
@media (hover:hover){.pl-k--land:hover .pl-k__land{transform:scale(1.05)}}
.pl-k--land .pl-k__t{position:relative;background:#fff;padding:12px 14px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;flex-wrap:wrap;font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:470;font-size:17px;color:var(--titel)}
.pl-k--land .pl-k__t svg{width:24px;height:16px;flex:none;border-radius:2px}
.pl-k--land .pl-k__t small{margin:0 0 0 auto;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--riegel)}
/* Preis */
.pl-k--preis{padding:20px}
.pl-k--preis b{display:block;font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:460;font-size:24px;color:var(--titel)}

/* Zahl und Leiste unten */
.pl-zahl{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:10px;margin:0}
.pl-zahl b{font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:440;font-size:clamp(2.4rem,3.4vw,3.2rem);line-height:1;color:var(--titel);font-variant-numeric:tabular-nums;min-width:2.2ch}
.pl-zahl span{font-size:17px;color:#4a4040}
.pl-leiste{position:sticky;bottom:12px;z-index:4;display:flex;align-items:center;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:12px 22px;margin-top:30px;padding:14px 16px 14px 24px;border-radius:14px;background:rgba(251,250,247,.97);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1),0 24px 40px -24px rgba(48,25,22,.55)}
.pl-weg{margin-left:auto;display:flex;gap:10px}
.pl-leiste--mitte{justify-content:center;position:static;box-shadow:none;background:none;padding:0}

/* Treffer: ruhiger, grösser, kurze Schrift; kommen gestaffelt an */
.weinneu .kb-treffer{grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:34px 18px;margin-top:clamp(40px,5vw,64px)}
.weinneu .kb-treffer .kb-fl__b,.weinneu .kb-tk__karte{height:clamp(200px,17vw,250px);padding:0 0 4px}
.weinneu .kb-fl__t{gap:3px;padding:16px 4px 0}
.weinneu .kb-treffer .kb-fl__t b{font-size:15.5px;display:-webkit-box;-webkit-line-clamp:2;-webkit-box-orient:vertical;overflow:hidden}
.weinneu .kb-treffer .kb-fl__t span.mono:nth-of-type(2){font:400 13px/1.3 "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:#7a6a64;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.weinneu .kb-treffer .kb-fl__t span.mono:nth-of-type(3){font:460 15px Petrona,serif;letter-spacing:0;text-transform:none;color:var(--titel)}
.weinneu .kb-treffer .kb-fl__t span.mono:first-child{font-size:10.5px}
.pl-neu{animation:plRein .8s var(--sanft) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * 40ms)}
@keyframes plRein{from{transform:translateY(34px)}to{transform:none}}

/* Fassung 1 und 6: Vier Fragen */
.pl-kopf{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:flex-start;gap:22px;padding-bottom:26px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.14)}
.pl-schritte{position:relative;display:flex;gap:4px}
.pl-schritte button{position:relative;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:12px 16px 16px;font:500 15px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;color:#7a6a64;text-align:left;transition:color .3s}
.pl-schritte button .mono{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--gold-tief);margin-bottom:3px}
.pl-schritte button small{display:block;font-weight:400;font-size:12px;color:var(--riegel);min-height:1.2em}
.pl-schritte button[aria-current="step"]{color:var(--titel)}
.pl-strich{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:-1px;width:100px;height:2px;background:var(--riegel);transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .6s var(--feder)}
.pl-buehne{overflow:hidden;padding:34px 4px 4px;margin:0 -4px}
.pl-rein{animation:plSchritt .7s var(--sanft) both}
@keyframes plSchritt{from{transform:translateX(calc(var(--r,1) * 60px))}to{transform:none}}

/* Fassung 2: Ein Satz */
.pl--2{text-align:center}
.pl-satzbau{font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:400;font-size:clamp(1.7rem,3vw,2.9rem);line-height:1.5;color:var(--titel);max-width:24em;margin:6px auto 10px}
.pl-wort{border:0;background:none;padding:0 .08em;font:inherit;color:var(--gold-tief);cursor:pointer;border-bottom:2px dotted rgba(179,131,70,.7);transition:color .3s,border-color .3s}
.pl-wort.gesetzt{color:var(--riegel);border-bottom:2px solid var(--riegel)}
.pl-wort.offen{color:var(--riegel);border-bottom-color:var(--gold)}
.pl-tipp{color:#8a7a74;font-size:14px;margin:0 0 26px}
.pl-fenster{text-align:left;margin:0 auto 30px;padding:clamp(20px,2.4vw,34px);border-radius:14px;background:var(--kalk);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1)}
.pl-fenster__kopf,.pl-pop__kopf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:flex-start;gap:20px;margin-bottom:16px}
.pl-fenster__kopf .pl-frage{margin:0}
.pl-auf{animation:plAuf .5s var(--feder) both;transform-origin:50% 0}
@keyframes plAuf{from{transform:translateY(-10px) scale(.97)}to{transform:none}}

/* Fassung 3 und 4: Leiste mit Fenstern */
.pl--3,.pl--4{background:none;box-shadow:none;padding:0}
.pl-start__kopf{text-align:center;max-width:980px;margin:0 auto 34px}.pl-start__kopf .pl-satz{margin:12px auto 0}
.pl-start__kopf--klein{margin-bottom:26px}
.pl-start__raster{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(6,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px;margin-bottom:34px}
.pl-st{position:relative;border:0;cursor:pointer;font:inherit;text-align:center;background:#FBFAF7;border-radius:16px;padding:26px 14px 22px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:16px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1),0 26px 44px -34px rgba(48,25,22,.6);transition:transform .5s var(--feder),box-shadow .35s}
@media (hover:hover){.pl-st:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}}
.pl-st:active{transform:scale(.96)}
.pl-st[aria-pressed="true"]{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--riegel),0 26px 44px -30px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.pl-st__bild{width:118px;height:118px}.pl-st__bild img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:contain;transition:transform .7s var(--feder)}
.pl-st[aria-pressed="true"] .pl-st__bild img{transform:scale(1.08) rotate(-4deg)}
.pl-st__t b{display:block;font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:470;font-size:21px;color:var(--titel)}
.pl-st__t small{display:block;color:#7a6a64;font-size:13.5px;line-height:1.35;margin-top:4px}
.pl-bar{position:sticky;top:12px;z-index:6;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:16px;padding:8px 8px 8px 8px;border-radius:14px;background:#FBFAF7;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1),0 22px 40px -28px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.pl-bar__knoepfe{display:flex;gap:4px;flex:1;min-width:0;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}
.pl-bk{flex:none;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:48px;padding:0 16px;border:0;border-radius:10px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font:500 15px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--tinte);transition:background-color .3s,transform .4s var(--feder)}
.pl-bk:hover{background:var(--kalk-warm)}.pl-bk:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.pl-bk svg{width:11px;height:8px;fill:none;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4;transition:transform .45s var(--feder)}
.pl-bk.offen svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.pl-bk.offen,.pl-bk.gesetzt{background:var(--riegel);color:var(--kalk)}
.pl-bk small{font:400 11px "DM Mono",monospace;background:rgba(255,255,255,.2);border-radius:9px;padding:0 6px;line-height:18px}.pl-bk small:empty{display:none}
.pl-bar__rechts{flex:none;padding-right:12px}
.pl-zahl--klein b{font-size:30px}.pl-zahl--klein span{font-size:15px}
.pl-pop{position:absolute;left:var(--x,0);top:calc(100% + 10px);width:min(860px,100%);max-height:min(640px,calc(100svh - 120px));overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:clamp(20px,2.4vw,32px);border-radius:16px;background:#FBFAF7;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1),0 50px 90px -30px rgba(48,25,22,.55)}
.pl-pop .pl-satz{margin-bottom:0}
.pl-pop .pl-raster--art{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-chips{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;align-items:center;gap:8px;margin-top:16px;min-height:38px}
.pl-chip{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;height:34px;padding:0 12px 0 14px;border:0;border-radius:17px;background:var(--kalk-tief);color:var(--titel);font:500 14px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;cursor:pointer;animation:plAuf .4s var(--feder) both}
.pl-chip svg{width:9px;height:9px;stroke:currentColor;stroke-width:1.4}
.pl-chips .pl-leeren{margin-left:6px}

/* Fassung 5: Konfigurator */
.pl--5{background:none;box-shadow:none;padding:0}
.pl-k5{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr) 360px;gap:clamp(24px,3vw,48px);align-items:start}
.pl-k5__links .pl-h{margin-bottom:26px}
.pl-ak{border-radius:14px;background:#FBFAF7;margin-bottom:10px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.08);transition:box-shadow .35s}

.pl-ak__kopf{width:100%;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr auto 14px;align-items:center;gap:18px;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:22px 26px;text-align:left;font:inherit}
.pl-ak__titel{font-family:Petrona,serif;font-weight:470;font-size:21px;color:var(--titel)}
.pl-ak__wahl{font-size:14px;color:#8a7a74;text-align:right;max-width:28ch;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.pl-ak.gesetzt .pl-ak__wahl{color:var(--riegel);font-weight:500}
.pl-ak__kopf svg{width:12px;height:8px;fill:none;stroke:var(--riegel);stroke-width:1.4;transition:transform .45s var(--feder)}
.pl-ak.offen .pl-ak__kopf svg{transform:rotate(180deg)}
.pl-ak__inhalt{padding:0 26px 26px}
.pl-k5 .pl-raster--art{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}
.pl-k5__rechts{position:sticky;top:20px}
.pl-k5__karte{background:var(--riegel) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px;color:#F4EADD;border-radius:16px;padding:30px 28px;box-shadow:0 40px 70px -40px rgba(48,25,22,.8)}
.pl-k5__karte>.mono{color:var(--gold-hell);margin:0 0 14px}
.pl-zahl--gross b{color:#fff;font-size:4rem}.pl-zahl--gross span{color:#EADFD2}
.pl-k5__liste{list-style:none;margin:22px 0 24px;padding:0}
.pl-k5__liste li{padding:10px 0;border-top:1px solid rgba(255,240,225,.16);font-size:15px;line-height:1.35}
.pl-k5__liste li .mono{display:block;font-size:10px;color:var(--gold-hell);margin-bottom:2px}
.pl-k5__liste li.leer{color:rgba(244,234,221,.45)}
.pl-k5__karte .kn{width:100%;justify-content:space-between}
.pl-k5__karte .pl-leeren{color:var(--gold-hell);margin-top:12px}

/* Fassung 6: Bühne auf Dunkel */
.pl--6{background:var(--tief) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px;color:#EDE5DA;box-shadow:0 60px 100px -50px rgba(30,12,10,.8)}
.pl--6 .pl-h,.pl--6 .pl-frage{color:#F7EFE4}.pl--6 .pl-ueber,.pl--6 .pl-unter{color:var(--gold-hell)}
.pl--6 .pl-satz{color:#CDBFB2}.pl--6 .pl-quelle{color:#9c8a80}
.pl--6 .pl-kopf{border-bottom-color:rgba(211,183,148,.2)}
.pl--6 .pl-schritte button{color:#a8978c}.pl--6 .pl-schritte button[aria-current="step"]{color:#F7EFE4}.pl--6 .pl-schritte button small{color:var(--gold-hell)}
.pl--6 .pl-strich{background:var(--gold)}
.pl--6 .pl-k{background:rgba(255,245,235,.06);color:#F1E8DD;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(211,183,148,.16)}
.pl--6 .pl-k__t small{color:#b9aa9e}
.pl--6 .pl-k[aria-pressed="true"]{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--gold),0 24px 40px -24px rgba(0,0,0,.7);background:rgba(211,183,148,.12)}
.pl--6 .pl-haken{background:var(--gold)}
.pl--6 .pl-k--art .pl-k__t,.pl--6 .pl-k--wort .pl-k__t,.pl--6 .pl-k--preis b{color:#F7EFE4}
.pl--6 .pl-k--art em,.pl--6 .pl-k--land .pl-k__t small{color:var(--gold-hell)}
.pl--6 .pl-k--land .pl-k__t{background:#3a201c;color:#F7EFE4}
.pl--6 .pl-punkte i{background:rgba(255,240,225,.14)}.pl--6 .pl-punkte i.voll{background:var(--gold)}
.pl--6 .pl-k__bild{background:#FBFAF7;border-radius:50%;padding:6px}
.pl--6 .pl-mehr{color:var(--gold-hell);border-bottom-color:rgba(211,183,148,.45)}
.pl--6 .pl-leiste{background:rgba(48,25,22,.97);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(211,183,148,.18),0 24px 40px -20px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.pl--6 .pl-zahl b{color:#fff}.pl--6 .pl-zahl span{color:#EADFD2}.pl--6 .pl-leeren{color:var(--gold-hell)}

/* Handy */
@media (max-width:1100px){.pl-raster--bild{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.weinneu .kb-treffer{grid-template-columns:repeat(4,minmax(0,1fr))}.pl-start__raster{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.pl-raster--art{grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr))}.pl-k5{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pl-k5__rechts{position:sticky;top:auto;bottom:10px;order:2}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .pl{border-radius:14px;padding:22px 16px}
  .pl--3,.pl--4,.pl--5{padding:0}
  .weinneu .kb-treffer{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:28px 12px}
  .pl-raster--bild,.pl-pop .pl-raster--bild,.pl-k5 .pl-raster--bild{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}

  .pl-raster--wort{grid-template-columns:1fr}.pl-raster--zwei{grid-template-columns:1fr;max-width:none}

  .pl-k__land{height:86px}
  .pl-k--land .pl-k__t{font-size:15px;padding:10px 12px}.pl-k--land .pl-k__t small{margin:0;width:100%}
  .pl-schritte{width:100%;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}.pl-schritte button{flex:none;padding:10px 12px 14px;font-size:14px}
  .pl-leiste{padding:10px 10px 10px 16px;gap:8px 12px}.pl-leiste .pl-leeren{display:none}
  .pl-zahl b{font-size:2.1rem}.pl-zahl span{font-size:14.5px}
  .pl-weg .kn--hell{display:none}
  .pl-start__raster{grid-template-columns:repeat(2,minmax(0,1fr));gap:10px}
  .pl-st{padding:18px 10px 16px;gap:10px}.pl-st__bild{width:84px;height:84px}.pl-st__t b{font-size:18px}
  .pl-bar{flex-direction:column;align-items:stretch;gap:6px;top:8px}
  .pl-bar__rechts{padding:0 8px 4px}
  .pl-pop{position:fixed;left:0;right:0;bottom:0;top:auto;width:auto;max-height:78svh;border-radius:18px 18px 0 0;z-index:95}
  .pl-pop.pl-auf{animation:plBlatt .5s var(--sanft) both}
  .pl-satzbau{font-size:1.55rem}
  .pl-ak__kopf{padding:18px 18px;gap:10px;grid-template-columns:1fr 14px}.pl-ak__wahl{grid-column:1;grid-row:2;text-align:left}.pl-ak__kopf svg{grid-column:2;grid-row:1}
  .pl-ak__inhalt{padding:0 16px 20px}
  .pl-k5__karte{padding:12px 12px 12px 18px;display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;border-radius:14px}.pl-k5__karte>.mono,.pl-k5__liste,.pl-k5__karte .pl-leeren{display:none}.pl-zahl--gross b{font-size:2.2rem}.pl-zahl--gross span{font-size:14px}.pl-k5__karte .kn{width:auto;margin-left:auto;--kh:46px;padding:0 14px;letter-spacing:.1em;flex:none}.pl-zahl span{white-space:nowrap}.pl-k5__karte .kn svg{display:none}
  
}
@keyframes plBlatt{from{transform:translateY(40%)}to{transform:none}}

/* Treffer als ruhige Liste (alle Fassungen ab 1): die Flaschenwand ist weg */
.weinneu .kb-treffer,.weinneu .kb-mehr{display:none!important}
.pl-liste{margin-top:clamp(36px,4vw,56px)}
.pl-gruppe{margin-bottom:30px}
.pl-gruppe__kopf{display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:14px;padding-bottom:10px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.3);font-size:clamp(1.4rem,1.8vw,1.75rem);color:var(--titel)}
.pl-gruppe__kopf .mono{font-size:11px;color:var(--riegel)}
.pl-liste .kb-z.pl-zeile{display:grid;grid-template-columns:44px minmax(0,1fr) 7em 5em 5.5em;gap:18px;align-items:center;padding:10px 0;border-top:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.12);transition:background-color .3s}
@media (hover:hover){.pl-liste .kb-z.pl-zeile:hover{background:rgba(255,255,255,.55)}.pl-zeile:hover .pl-zeile__fl img{transform:translateY(-3px)}}
.pl-zeile__fl{height:62px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}
.pl-zeile__fl img{max-height:62px;width:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 5px rgba(48,25,22,.25));transition:transform .5s var(--feder)}
.pl-zeile__n b{display:block;font-weight:500;font-size:16.5px;line-height:1.3}
.pl-zeile__n small{display:block;font-size:13.5px;color:#7a6a64;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.pl-zeile__j,.pl-zeile__g{font:400 12px "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--riegel)}
.pl-zeile__p{text-align:right;font:460 18px Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}
.pl-liste__fuss{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;align-items:center;gap:16px;flex-wrap:wrap;margin-top:6px;color:#7a6a64;font-size:14.5px}
.pl-leer{text-align:center;color:#5a4c48;padding:30px 0}
.pl-st__land{display:block;width:100%;height:100%;border-radius:50%;background-size:cover;background-position:center}
.pl-st__bild img.pl-st__fl{filter:drop-shadow(0 10px 8px rgba(48,25,22,.3))}
@media (max-width:760px){.pl-liste .kb-z.pl-zeile{grid-template-columns:34px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:12px}.pl-zeile__j,.pl-zeile__g{display:none}.pl-zeile__fl{height:52px}.pl-zeile__fl img{max-height:52px}.pl-zeile__n b{font-size:15.5px}}

/* Fassung 7 (Runde 2): Menü oder à la carte. Gänge als Riegelwand: Foto der Küche, Gang, Wein, getrennt von Balken in Ochsenblut */
.weinneu .pl-liste{display:none}
.pl--7{padding:clamp(30px,4vw,64px) clamp(16px,3vw,48px) clamp(24px,3vw,40px)}
.pl7-kopf{text-align:center;max-width:780px;margin:0 auto 32px}.pl7-kopf .pl-satz{margin:14px auto 0;font-size:17px}
.pl7-wahl{position:relative;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 38px;padding:6px;border-radius:14px;background:var(--kalk-tief);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 3px rgba(48,25,22,.18)}
.pl7-wahl button{position:relative;z-index:1;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:20px 14px;border-radius:10px;color:var(--riegel);transition:color .5s var(--sanft)}
.pl7-wahl button b{display:block;font:470 24px Petrona,serif;letter-spacing:.01em}
.pl7-wahl button small{display:block;font-size:13.5px;opacity:.85;margin-top:3px}
.pl7-wahl button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--kalk)}
.pl7-wahl__thumb{position:absolute;z-index:0;top:6px;bottom:6px;left:6px;width:calc(50% - 6px);border-radius:10px;background:linear-gradient(180deg,#8f4c42 0%,var(--riegel) 50%,#6a372f 100%);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 0 rgba(255,236,220,.25),0 14px 26px -12px rgba(48,25,22,.8);transition:transform .75s var(--feder)}
.pl7-gaenge{display:flex;justify-content:center;gap:12px;margin-bottom:26px}
.pl7-gaenge button{position:relative;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;padding:15px 26px;display:flex;align-items:baseline;gap:12px;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.14);transition:transform .5s var(--feder),box-shadow .35s}
.pl7-gaenge button b{font:470 20px Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}.pl7-gaenge button span{font:400 12px "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--riegel)}
.pl7-gaenge button:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.pl7-gaenge button[aria-pressed="true"]{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--riegel),0 18px 28px -18px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.pl7-zeile{text-align:center;font:460 clamp(1.3rem,1.7vw,1.6rem)/1.3 Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel);margin:0 0 22px}

/* Die Wand: jede Zeile ein Gang */
.pl7-wand{display:grid;gap:var(--balken);background:var(--riegel);padding:var(--balken);border-radius:3px}
.pl7-wand:empty{display:none}
.pl7-gang{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.78fr) minmax(0,1fr) minmax(0,1.22fr);gap:var(--balken);min-height:clamp(330px,26vw,400px)}
.pl7-gang--rechts .pl7-gang__bild{order:3}.pl7-gang--rechts .pl7-gang__wein{order:2}.pl7-gang--rechts .pl7-gang__speise{order:1}
.pl7-gang__bild{position:relative;overflow:hidden;background:var(--tief);border-radius:2px}
.pl7-gang__bild img{position:absolute;inset:0;width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.6s var(--sanft)}
@media (hover:hover){.pl7-gang:hover .pl7-gang__bild img{transform:scale(1.045)}}
.pl7-gang__bild--ohne{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;background:var(--tief) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px;padding:20px}
.pl7-gang__bild--ohne span{font:470 clamp(1.2rem,1.6vw,1.5rem)/1.3 Petrona,serif;color:var(--gold-hell);text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.pl7-gang__speise{background:var(--kalk);border-radius:2px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;justify-content:center;text-align:center;padding:clamp(22px,2.6vw,40px)}
.pl7-gang__speise h4{margin:0;font:470 clamp(1.25rem,1.7vw,1.6rem)/1.25 Petrona,serif;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--titel)}
.pl7-gang__speise p{margin:8px 0 0;color:#5a4c48;font-size:16px;line-height:1.45}
.pl7-linie{display:block;width:44px;height:1px;background:var(--gold);margin:18px 0 0}
.pl7-gang__speise .pl7-warum,.pl7-warum{color:#8a7a74;font-size:14px;margin-top:14px;max-width:30ch}
.pl7-gang__wein{background:#FBFAF7;border-radius:2px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:20px;padding:clamp(20px,2.4vw,36px) clamp(18px,2.4vw,40px)}
.pl7-buehne{display:grid;min-height:230px}
.pl7-buehne>*{grid-area:1/1}
.pl7-wein.kb-z{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(80px,30%) minmax(0,1fr);gap:clamp(14px,1.8vw,26px);align-items:center;width:100%;border:0;padding:0;background:none;text-align:left;cursor:pointer}
.pl7-wein__fl{height:clamp(200px,17vw,240px);display:flex;align-items:flex-end;justify-content:center}
.pl7-wein__fl img{max-height:100%;width:auto;max-width:100%;filter:drop-shadow(0 22px 16px rgba(48,25,22,.28));transform-origin:50% 100%;transition:transform .7s var(--feder)}
@media (hover:hover){.pl7-wein.kb-z:hover .pl7-wein__fl img{transform:translateY(-6px) rotate(-1.5deg)}.pl7-wein.kb-z:hover .pl7-mehr{color:var(--riegel)}}
.pl7-jahr{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;width:100%;height:70%;font:430 clamp(2.4rem,3.4vw,3.4rem) Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel);border-bottom:1px solid var(--gold);height:auto;padding-bottom:10px;width:auto}
.pl7-wein__t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;min-width:0}
.pl7-wein__t .mono{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--riegel)}
.pl7-wein__t b{font:470 clamp(1.3rem,1.6vw,1.6rem)/1.2 Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel);margin:4px 0 4px}
.pl7-wein__t small{font-size:14.5px;color:#5a4c48;line-height:1.4}
.pl7-wein__p{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:10px;margin-top:12px;font:460 17px Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}
.pl7-wein__p i{width:18px;height:1px;background:var(--gold)}
.pl7-mehr{margin-top:14px;font-size:10.5px!important;color:#9a8a82!important;transition:color .3s}
/* Preisstufen als Worte, der goldene Strich gleitet mit */
.pl7-stufen{position:relative;display:flex;gap:4px;border-top:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.14);padding-top:6px}
.pl7-stufen button{border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:10px 12px 12px;font:400 11px "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.12em;text-transform:uppercase;color:#9a8a82;transition:color .4s var(--sanft)}
.pl7-stufen button:hover:not(:disabled){color:var(--riegel)}
.pl7-stufen button[aria-pressed="true"]{color:var(--titel)}
.pl7-stufen button:disabled{opacity:.3;cursor:default}
.pl7-stufen__strich{position:absolute;left:0;bottom:0;width:100px;height:2px;background:var(--gold);transform-origin:0 50%;transition:transform .7s var(--feder)}
/* Wechsel: die alte Flasche hebt sich weg, die neue steigt auf */
.pl7-geht{animation:pl7Geht .32s var(--sanft) forwards;pointer-events:none}
.pl7-kommt .pl7-wein__t{animation:pl7Text .8s var(--sanft) .4s both}

@keyframes pl7Geht{to{transform:translateY(-16px);opacity:0}}
@keyframes pl7Text{from{transform:translateY(16px);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
@keyframes pl7Flasche{from{transform:translateY(46px) scale(.96);opacity:0}to{transform:none;opacity:1}}
.pl7-rein{animation:pl7Rein 1s var(--sanft) both;animation-delay:calc(var(--i) * 70ms)}
@keyframes pl7Rein{from{transform:translateY(36px)}to{transform:none}}

/* À la carte: das eigene Menü, Kapitel für Kapitel */
.pl7-auswahl{display:grid;gap:30px;margin-bottom:38px}
.pl7-kapitel{display:grid;grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.7fr) minmax(0,3fr);gap:clamp(18px,2.4vw,36px);align-items:start;padding-top:26px;border-top:1px solid rgba(179,131,70,.4)}

.pl7-kapitel h3 .mono{display:block;font-size:11px;color:var(--riegel);margin-bottom:8px}
.pl7-teller{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,minmax(0,1fr));gap:14px}
.pl7-tl{position:relative;border:0;padding:0;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;background:#fff;border-radius:12px;overflow:hidden;display:flex;flex-direction:column;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1),0 20px 34px -28px rgba(48,25,22,.6);transition:transform .55s var(--feder),box-shadow .4s var(--sanft)}
@media (hover:hover){.pl7-tl:hover{transform:translateY(-4px)}.pl7-tl:hover .pl7-tl__bild img{transform:scale(1.06)}}
.pl7-tl:active{transform:scale(.97)}
.pl7-tl[aria-pressed="true"]{box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--riegel),0 26px 40px -26px rgba(48,25,22,.7)}
.pl7-tl__bild{display:block;aspect-ratio:4/3;overflow:hidden;background:var(--kalk-tief)}
.pl7-tl__bild img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;transition:transform 1.2s var(--sanft)}
.pl7-tl__bild--ohne{display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;padding:14px;background:var(--tief) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px}
.pl7-tl__bild--ohne em{font:470 17px/1.3 Petrona,serif;font-style:normal;color:var(--gold-hell);text-align:center;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.1em}
.pl7-tl__t{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:3px;padding:14px 16px 16px}
.pl7-tl__t b{font:470 17px/1.25 Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}
.pl7-tl__t small{font-size:13.5px;color:#7a6a64;line-height:1.35}
.pl7-tl__t em{font:400 11px "DM Mono",monospace;font-style:normal;letter-spacing:.1em;color:var(--riegel);margin-top:6px}
.pl7-tl .pl-haken{top:12px;right:12px;width:28px;height:28px}

@media (max-width:1100px){.pl7-gang{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,.8fr) minmax(0,1.2fr);grid-template-rows:auto auto}.pl7-gang__bild{grid-row:1/3}.pl7-gang--rechts .pl7-gang__bild{order:0}.pl7-kapitel{grid-template-columns:1fr}}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .pl--7{padding:26px 12px 20px}
  .pl7-wahl button{padding:15px 8px}.pl7-wahl button b{font-size:20px}.pl7-wahl button small{font-size:12px}
  .pl7-gaenge{gap:8px}.pl7-gaenge button{padding:12px 14px;flex-direction:column;gap:2px;align-items:center}.pl7-gaenge button b{font-size:18px}
  .pl7-wand{padding:8px;gap:8px}
  .pl7-gang{grid-template-columns:1fr;gap:8px;min-height:0}
  .pl7-gang__bild{grid-row:auto;aspect-ratio:4/3}
  .pl7-gang__speise{padding:22px 18px}
  .pl7-gang__wein{padding:18px 16px;gap:14px}
  .pl7-buehne{min-height:190px}
  .pl7-wein__fl{height:180px}
  .pl7-stufen button{padding:10px 8px 12px;font-size:10px;letter-spacing:.08em}
  .pl7-teller{grid-template-columns:none;grid-auto-flow:column;grid-auto-columns:72%;overflow-x:auto;scroll-snap-type:x mandatory;margin:0 -12px;padding:4px 12px 14px;scrollbar-width:none}
  .pl7-tl{scroll-snap-align:start}
}

/* Fassung 7 Runde 3: Flaschen fest in der Höhe (Safari), Abend in Flaschen, weitere Weine im Fenster, ganze Karte */
.pl7-wein__fl img{max-height:clamp(200px,17vw,240px)!important}
.pl7-andere{margin-left:auto;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;padding:10px 4px 12px 12px;font:500 14px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--riegel);display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px}
.pl7-andere::after{content:"";width:18px;height:1px;background:currentColor;transition:transform .45s var(--feder);transform-origin:0 50%}
.pl7-andere:hover::after{transform:scaleX(1.6)}
.pl7-wie{margin:12px 0 0!important;font-size:10.5px!important;color:var(--gold-tief)!important}

/* Unsere Idee für den Abend */
.pl7-abend{margin:0 0 var(--balken);border-radius:3px;background:var(--tief) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px;color:#EDE5DA;padding:clamp(26px,3.4vw,52px)}
.pl7-abend__kopf{max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 26px;text-align:center}
.pl7-abend__kopf .mono{color:var(--gold-hell);margin:0 0 10px}
.pl7-abend__kopf h3{margin:0;font:460 clamp(1.7rem,2.6vw,2.5rem)/1.15 Petrona,serif;color:#F7EFE4}
.pl7-abend__kopf p{margin:14px auto 0;color:#CDBFB2;font-size:16px;max-width:56ch}
.pl7-abend__reihe{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;justify-content:center;gap:16px}
.pl7-abend__fl{flex:1 1 360px;max-width:520px;background:#FBFAF7;border-radius:12px;padding:22px 24px 18px;color:var(--tinte);box-shadow:0 30px 50px -30px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.pl7-abend__fl .pl7-wein__fl{height:clamp(170px,14vw,200px)}.pl7-abend__fl .pl7-wein__fl img{max-height:clamp(170px,14vw,200px)!important}
.pl7-abend__fuer{margin:14px 0 0;padding-top:12px;border-top:1px solid rgba(179,131,70,.4);font:460 15.5px/1.4 Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}
.pl7-abend__fuer .mono{display:block;font-size:10.5px;color:var(--gold-tief);margin-bottom:4px}
.pl7-abend__glas{flex:0 1 260px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;justify-content:center;gap:4px;padding:22px 24px;border-radius:12px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(211,183,148,.35)}
.pl7-abend__glas .mono{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--gold-hell)}
.pl7-abend__glas b{font:460 20px/1.25 Petrona,serif;color:#F7EFE4}
.pl7-abend__glas small{font-size:14px;color:#CDBFB2;line-height:1.4}
.pl7-abend__unten{text-align:center;margin:26px 0 0!important;color:var(--gold-hell)!important;font-size:10.5px!important}
/* Fenster: weitere Weine und Suche */
.pl7-dlg{border:0;padding:0;width:min(760px,calc(100vw - 24px));max-height:min(86svh,860px);border-radius:16px;background:#FBFAF7;color:var(--tinte);box-shadow:0 60px 120px -40px rgba(0,0,0,.7);overflow:hidden;display:none;flex-direction:column}
.pl7-dlg[open]{display:flex;animation:pl7Dlg .55s var(--feder)}
.pl7-dlg::backdrop{background:rgba(30,15,12,.62)}
@keyframes pl7Dlg{from{transform:translateY(40px) scale(.98)}to{transform:none}}
.pl7-dlg__kopf{display:flex;justify-content:space-between;gap:20px;padding:28px 30px 16px;background:var(--riegel) url(/werkzeuge/website/_probe/schaefli/grundlage/assets/zeichen/tapete-a-dunkel.svg) 0 0/168px 168px;color:#F4EADD}
.pl7-dlg__kopf .mono{color:var(--gold-hell);margin:0 0 6px}
.pl7-dlg__kopf h3{margin:0;font:460 clamp(1.5rem,2.4vw,2rem)/1.15 Petrona,serif;color:#fff}
.pl7-dlg__satz{margin:8px 0 0;color:#EADFD2;font-size:15px}
.pl7-dlg__zu{flex:none;width:44px;height:44px;border-radius:50%;border:0;cursor:pointer;background:rgba(255,240,225,.14);display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;transition:transform .4s var(--feder)}
.pl7-dlg__zu:hover{transform:rotate(90deg)}.pl7-dlg__zu svg{width:14px;height:14px;stroke:#fff;stroke-width:1.6}
.pl7-suche{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:12px;margin:18px 30px 0;padding:0 18px;height:54px;border-radius:12px;background:#fff;box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.16),0 14px 26px -22px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.pl7-suche svg{width:18px;height:18px;flex:none;fill:none;stroke:var(--riegel);stroke-width:1.6}
.pl7-suche input{flex:1;border:0;background:none;font:400 16.5px "Instrument Sans",sans-serif;color:var(--tinte);outline:none;height:100%}
.pl7-dlg__zwischen{margin:16px 30px 6px!important;font-size:10.5px!important;color:var(--gold-tief)}
.pl7-dlg__liste{overflow:auto;overscroll-behavior:contain;padding:0 18px 22px}
.pl7-wz{display:grid;grid-template-columns:46px minmax(0,1fr) auto auto;gap:16px;align-items:center;width:100%;border:0;background:none;cursor:pointer;text-align:left;padding:10px 12px;border-radius:10px;transition:background-color .3s}
.pl7-wz:hover{background:var(--kalk-warm)}
.pl7-wz__fl{height:64px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center}.pl7-wz__fl img{max-height:64px;width:auto;filter:drop-shadow(0 6px 5px rgba(48,25,22,.25))}
.pl7-wz__t b{display:block;font:470 17px/1.25 Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}
.pl7-wz__t small{display:block;font-size:13.5px;color:#7a6a64;white-space:nowrap;overflow:hidden;text-overflow:ellipsis}
.pl7-wz__p{text-align:right;font:400 11px "DM Mono",monospace;color:var(--riegel);letter-spacing:.06em}.pl7-wz__p b{display:block;font:460 17px Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel);letter-spacing:0}
.pl7-wz__w{font-size:10.5px!important;padding:8px 12px;border-radius:8px;color:var(--riegel);box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.3);transition:background-color .3s,color .3s}
.pl7-wz:hover .pl7-wz__w{background:var(--riegel);color:var(--kalk)}
/* Fenster in die ganze Karte */
.weinneu .fenster--keller .fenster__satz{top:calc(50% - 1.05em)}
/* Die ganze Karte, in der Form des Hauses */
.gk{padding:var(--pol) 0}
.gk__kopf{text-align:center;max-width:760px;margin:0 auto 34px}
.gk__kopf .mono{color:var(--riegel);margin:0 0 12px}
.gk__kopf p{color:#5a4c48;font-size:17px;margin:14px auto 0}
.gk__filter{position:sticky;top:10px;z-index:5;display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr minmax(260px,360px);gap:10px 14px;padding:12px;border-radius:16px;background:rgba(251,250,247,.98);box-shadow:0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.1),0 26px 44px -30px rgba(48,25,22,.6);margin-bottom:40px}
.gk__suche{margin:0;height:auto;min-height:48px;box-shadow:inset 0 0 0 1px rgba(125,67,58,.16)}
.gk__wahl{display:flex;flex-wrap:wrap;gap:4px;padding:4px;border-radius:11px;background:var(--kalk-tief);box-shadow:inset 0 1px 2px rgba(48,25,22,.15)}
.gk__wahl--land{grid-column:1/-1}
.gk__wahl button{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:8px;border:0;border-radius:8px;padding:10px 13px;background:none;cursor:pointer;font:400 11.5px "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--riegel);transition:background-color .35s var(--sanft),color .35s,transform .4s var(--feder)}
.gk__wahl button:active{transform:scale(.95)}
.gk__wahl button small{opacity:.7;font-size:10.5px}
.gk__wahl button svg{width:20px;height:13px;border-radius:2px}
.gk__wahl button[aria-pressed="true"]{background:var(--riegel);color:var(--kalk);box-shadow:0 8px 16px -10px rgba(48,25,22,.8)}
.gk__zahl{grid-column:1/-1;text-align:center;margin:2px 0 0!important;color:var(--gold-tief);font-size:10.5px!important}
.gk__art{display:flex;align-items:center;gap:22px;margin:54px 0 30px;font:400 13px "DM Mono",monospace;letter-spacing:.32em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--riegel)}
.gk__art::before,.gk__art::after{content:"";flex:1;height:1px;background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(179,131,70,0),rgba(179,131,70,.7))}
.gk__art::after{background:linear-gradient(90deg,rgba(179,131,70,.7),rgba(179,131,70,0))}
.gk__land{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:6px;margin:34px 0 20px;text-align:center}
.gk__land svg{width:44px;height:29px;border-radius:3px;box-shadow:0 6px 14px -8px rgba(48,25,22,.6)}
.gk__land h4{margin:0;font:470 clamp(1.4rem,2vw,1.9rem) Petrona,serif;letter-spacing:.14em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--titel)}
.gk__land .mono{font-size:10.5px;color:var(--gold-tief)}
.gk__guete{display:grid;grid-template-columns:1fr 1fr;gap:var(--balken);align-items:start;background:var(--riegel);padding:var(--balken);border-radius:3px}
.gk__saeule{display:grid;gap:var(--balken)}
.gk__gut{background:#FBFAF7;border-radius:2px;padding:22px 24px 14px}
.gk__gut header{display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;text-align:center;gap:6px;padding-bottom:14px;margin-bottom:6px;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(179,131,70,.4)}
.gk__logo{height:48px;display:flex;align-items:center}.gk__logo img{max-height:48px;max-width:150px;width:auto;height:auto}
.gk__mono{width:46px;height:46px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:center;border:1px solid var(--gold);border-radius:50%;font:470 15px Petrona,serif;letter-spacing:.06em;color:var(--titel)}
.gk__gut h5{margin:4px 0 0;font:470 17px/1.3 Petrona,serif;letter-spacing:.1em;text-transform:uppercase;color:var(--titel)}

.gk__z{display:grid;grid-template-columns:3.6em minmax(0,1fr) auto 3.8em;gap:12px;align-items:baseline;width:100%;border:0;border-bottom:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.1);background:none;padding:10px 6px;text-align:left;cursor:pointer;color:var(--tinte);border-radius:6px;transition:background-color .3s}
.gk__z:last-child{border-bottom:0}
.gk__z:hover{background:var(--kalk-warm)}
.gk__j,.gk__g{font-size:11px!important;color:var(--riegel)}
.gk__n{font-size:15.5px;line-height:1.35}.gk__n small{display:block;font-size:13px;color:#8a7a74}
.gk__p{text-align:right;font:460 16px Petrona,serif;color:var(--titel)}
@media (max-width:760px){
  .pl7-wein__fl img{max-height:180px!important}
  .pl7-andere{margin-left:0;padding-left:8px}
  .pl7-abend{padding:24px 14px}.pl7-abend__fl{padding:18px 16px 14px}.pl7-abend__glas{flex:1 1 100%}
  .pl7-dlg__kopf{padding:22px 20px 14px}.pl7-suche{margin:14px 16px 0}.pl7-dlg__zwischen{margin:14px 20px 4px!important}.pl7-dlg__liste{padding:0 6px 16px}
  .pl7-wz{grid-template-columns:36px minmax(0,1fr) auto;gap:10px}.pl7-wz__w{display:none}
  .gk__filter{position:static;grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .gk__wahl{flex-wrap:nowrap;overflow-x:auto;scrollbar-width:none}.gk__wahl button{flex:none}
  .gk__guete{grid-template-columns:1fr;padding:8px;gap:8px}.gk__saeule{gap:8px}.gk__gut{padding:18px 14px 10px}
  .gk__z{grid-template-columns:3em minmax(0,1fr) 3.4em;gap:8px}.gk__g{display:none}
}
@media (max-width:760px){.pl7-gang{grid-template-columns:minmax(0,1fr)!important}.pl7-gang__wein,.pl7-gang__speise{min-width:0}.pl7-stufen{flex-wrap:wrap}.pl7-andere{flex-basis:100%;justify-content:flex-start;border-top:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.1);margin-top:4px}}
.pl7-stufen{flex-wrap:wrap}.pl7-andere{flex-basis:100%;margin-left:0;justify-content:flex-start;padding:12px 12px 4px;border-top:1px solid rgba(125,67,58,.1);margin-top:4px}
/* Bilder nur für die Weinseite (Robert 20.10.2026: keine Doppelungen mit anderen Seiten) */
.fenster__drei{display:grid;grid-template-columns:repeat(3,1fr);gap:var(--balken);background:var(--riegel);padding:0 var(--balken)}

.pl7-abend__fabian{display:block;width:84px;height:84px;margin:0 auto 14px;border-radius:50%;overflow:hidden;box-shadow:0 0 0 2px var(--gold),0 14px 24px -12px rgba(0,0,0,.7)}
.pl7-abend__fabian img{width:100%;height:100%;object-fit:cover;object-position:50% 25%}
.pl7-abend__reihe{flex-wrap:nowrap;align-items:stretch}
.pl7-abend__glaeser{flex:0 1 270px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
.pl7-abend__glaeser .pl7-abend__glas{flex:1 1 auto}
@media (max-width:1100px){.pl7-abend__reihe{flex-wrap:wrap}.pl7-abend__glaeser{flex:1 1 100%;flex-direction:row;flex-wrap:wrap}.pl7-abend__glaeser .pl7-abend__glas{flex:1 1 220px}}
/* Bild je Gang: die Landschaft des gewählten Weins, sie wechselt mit der Flasche */
.pl7-gang__bild img{transition:none}
.pl7-gang__bild .pl7-neu-bild{animation:pl7Bild .9s var(--sanft) both}
@keyframes pl7Bild{from{opacity:0;transform:scale(1.02)}to{opacity:1;transform:none}}
.pl7-gang__ort{position:absolute;left:12px;right:12px;bottom:12px;z-index:1;background:var(--kalk);border-radius:2px;padding:9px 12px;font-size:10.5px!important;color:var(--riegel);text-align:center}

.pl7-tl{min-height:150px;background:#FBFAF7;justify-content:center}

.gk__filter,.js .gk__filter[data-a].da{position:relative!important;top:auto}
